readings: Using only the player_award_vote table, join each vote record to player on player_id (inner join, so votes with no matching player are dropped). Exclude players whose death_country is NULL or an empty string. Group by death_country. For each group, return death_country, the average points_won (ignoring NULLs), and the signed difference between that group's average and the unweighted mean of all the group averages (the mean of the per-country averages, not a mean over individual votes). Don't round.

Using only the manager_award_vote table, join each vote record to player on player_id (inner join, so votes with no matching player are dropped). Exclude players whose death_country is NULL or an empty string. Group by death_country. For each group, return death_country, the average points_won (ignoring NULLs), and the signed difference between that group's average and the unweighted mean of all the group averages (the mean of the per-country averages, not a mean over individual votes). Don't round.

Combine all vote records from player_award_vote and manager_award_vote with UNION ALL, so both tables count as award vote records. Join each record to player on player_id (inner join, so votes with no matching player are dropped). Exclude players whose death_country is NULL or an empty string. Group by death_country. For each group, return death_country, the average points_won over the combined records (ignoring NULLs), and the signed difference between that group's average and the unweighted mean of all the group averages (the mean of the per-country averages, not a mean over individual votes). Don't round.
queries:
WITH g AS (
  SELECT p.death_country AS death_country, AVG(v.points_won) AS avg_points
  FROM player_award_vote v
  JOIN player p ON v.player_id = p.player_id
  WHERE p.death_country IS NOT NULL AND p.death_country <> ''
  GROUP BY p.death_country
)
SELECT death_country,
       avg_points,
       avg_points - (SELECT AVG(avg_points) FROM g) AS diff_from_mean
FROM g;
WITH g AS (
    SELECT p.death_country AS death_country, AVG(m.points_won) AS avg_points
    FROM manager_award_vote m
    JOIN player p ON m.player_id = p.player_id
    WHERE p.death_country IS NOT NULL AND p.death_country <> ''
    GROUP BY p.death_country
)
SELECT death_country,
       avg_points,
       avg_points - (SELECT AVG(avg_points) FROM g) AS diff_from_mean
FROM g;
WITH votes AS (
    SELECT player_id, points_won FROM player_award_vote
    UNION ALL
    SELECT player_id, points_won FROM manager_award_vote
),
country_avg AS (
    SELECT p.death_country AS death_country, AVG(v.points_won) AS avg_points
    FROM votes v
    JOIN player p ON v.player_id = p.player_id
    WHERE p.death_country IS NOT NULL AND p.death_country <> ''
    GROUP BY p.death_country
)
SELECT death_country,
       avg_points,
       avg_points - (SELECT AVG(avg_points) FROM country_avg) AS diff_from_mean
FROM country_avg;
